# Hélain Zimmermann

> Co-Founder & CTO at Ailog. AI engineer who builds AI systems and the companies around them: retrieval, agents and fine-tuning. Trained at ENSIMAG (Grenoble) and KTH (Stockholm), with research at INRIA on privacy-preserving natural language processing.

This site is a single page, written as an interview in five questions. Everything it says is below.

## Who

- Name: Hélain Zimmermann
- Role: Co-Founder & CTO at [Ailog](https://www.ailog.fr/)
- Ships: retrieval, agents, fine-tuning
- Method: code, not slides. Papers only when they exist.

## What he builds

- Pylae (gateway): one European gate to every large language model. Your own keys, and each provider's jurisdiction stated plainly.
- Delona (explainers): research explained with figures you can move. One idea per article, reviewed before it goes out.
- Nefeli (dev server): an agent-first development server in the cloud. AI agents, a terminal and your files in one browser tab, on a phone or a computer. It sits on a private network, closed to the open internet.

## Engineering record

- A RISC-V processor (VHDL, run on FPGA)
- A JPEG encoder (C, from scratch)
- Image resizing on GPU (10 to 100 times faster)
- Firefighting robots (A* planning, Java)
- A home-automation hub (ESP32, Docker)
- [A published paper on privacy in NLP](https://arxiv.org/html/2501.02407v2) (INRIA)

## Training

- ENSIMAG, Grenoble: engineering degree in computer science and applied mathematics
- INRIA, Grenoble: research on privacy-preserving natural language processing
- KTH, Stockholm: Master of Science in Machine Learning
